fns.desc: os_malloc(2 * info_len + 1) where info_len = msg->session_info_len is attacker-controlled (parsed from an 802.11 P2P PD Response wire frame); no explicit upper-bound check before the doubling multiply, relying only on the frame's own size limits. Low practical risk (frame size caps info_len well below overflow range) but no defensive bound is asserted.
